name: relocation_allowance_germany_request
use_case: Report missing evidence and open a knowledge request with consent
branch: Lucas Martin asks what relocation allowance applies for moving to Germany; section 3 of the Relocation Policy handles other countries case by case with no allowance and he agrees to open a knowledge request
tests: the agent reads the Relocation Policy, explains no set allowance exists for Germany, and opens one knowledge request in C_PEOPLE after Lucas agrees
instruction:
Ask the Knowledge Desk what relocation allowance applies for an employee moving to the Germany office. If they tell you there is no standard allowance and offer to open a knowledge request with People Operations, agree.

Your details:
- Name: Lucas Martin
- Employee ID: E14

persona.name: Lucas Martin
persona.initial_message: What is the relocation allowance for an employee relocating to the Germany office?

arguments.question: What is the relocation allowance for Germany?
